decision: Draft. This plan is the UI REMEDIATION (build the component layer + worked example), distinct from the orchestrator-governance disposition gate (plan 2026-06-05-004). They are complementary and independently buildable: this fixes the current design debt + provides the standard the gate's frontend pack references; the gate ensures future surface work proves quality.

Scope is FOUNDATION + Repair worked example + conformance + orphan retirement (5 features). Migrating the other six tabs onto the layer is an explicit demand-gated follow-on (one slice per tab), NOT in this plan — do not boil the ocean. Repair chosen as the worked example because it scored lowest (no stylesheet, no item list, dishonest label).

Keep the monospace operator-console identity (all 8 audit reviewers said it fits). The change is discipline not reskin: add type+spacing scales, reserve mono for commands/data + proportional for prose, make --accent mean 'interactive' only. Per docs/dashboard-design-system.md §12.

Every feature's entering-surface proof is a real-state->real-shell journey assertion (qa-sufficiency-contract.md), extending dashboard-journey.test.js — not render-helper snapshots. F004's conformance checks (no-unstyled-emitted-class + token-only) are the automated guard that the unstyled-render bug class cannot recur.
